# Palmieri Extension Study

I need your help with a research study extending the Palmieri et al. (2015) phase field model of cancer cell migration to larger systems, multiple cancer cells, and heterogeneous populations.

Before doing anything, please read these files to get up to speed:
1. The agent instructions: `.github/instructions/palmieri-extension.instructions.md`
2. The study logbook: `cpp/simulation/study/palmieri_extension/LOG_BOOK.md`
3. The supervisor's research plan: `palmieri_model_2d_extensions.pdf` (at the repo root)

After reading, give me a brief status summary: what equilibrations are complete, what production runs exist, what analyses have been done, and what you recommend as the highest-priority next step. Don't start running anything yet.
